changelog:
- Initial release of AI Data Visualizer.
- Automatically analyzes CSV/JSON data to recommend and generate optimal chart combinations.
- Generates interactive HTML dashboards featuring line, bar, scatter, and pie/donut charts.
- Supports dark/light theme switching and responsive layouts.
- Provides embedded statistical summaries (mean, median, min/max) and data table previews.
- Includes CLI options for input format, output path, theme, and dashboard title.
